sentences.text:
Govardhan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September,
2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:26818
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Indore

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi

On The 13th Of September, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 37005 of 2024
 Govardhan
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Pramod C. Nair - advocate for the petitioner.
Ajay Raj Gupta Ga appearing on behalf of Advocate Gener  Shri Aditya Jain, counsel for the respondent [OBJ].
ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.273/2024 dated -6.6.2024 registered at Police Station : Mahidpur,
District - Ujjain (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
2. As per prosecution story, applicant seduced the victim to elope with him and he made physical relationship with her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that age of the victim is very much in dispute.
For this he has referred birth certificate of the victim and also entry in the scholar register.
He further submits that he has been falsely implicated.
The victim is major and she with her own consent had eloped with the applicant and performed marriage with him.
Applicant is in custody since 25.12.2023 and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time, therefore, it is prayed that present applicant/accused be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26818 2 MCRC-37005-2024 4.
Learned counsel for State opposed the prayer on the ground that investigation is still going on and co-accused Balu is absconding.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for objector opposed the application by stating that applicant committed rape with the minor prosecutrix, hence no leniency is required.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary, it transpires that date of birth of prosecutrix is in dispute as per her birth certificate and entry in the scholar register are concerned.
Marriage certificate has also been filed.
In the aforesaid factual backdrop, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Goverdhan shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for his appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
With the aforesaid, the petition is allowed and disposed off.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
